vibe.verdict: A neat staff canteen and efficiency review slip, but it leans on Chicago and the North Pole in general and misses Slam, Chirp Chirp and the naughty list.
missing: Slam at the top of the naughty list (Fred marks everyone nice)
Chirp Chirp's birdhouse (Nick's gift to Fred)
DJ Donnie and the nonstop Here Comes Santa Claus
The three-strike assessment from Clyde Northcutt
The intervention with Fred's family and Wanda
ideas: Swap the note on 'Everybody's nice marshmallow cocoa' for 'Fred marks every naughty child as nice.'
Swap the slip text 'North Pole, under review' for 'Three strikes and the workshop shuts.'
Swap 'Iced gingerbread men' for 'Chirp Chirp birdhouse cookies', the replica Nick gives Fred.
Swap the house note on 'Caramel popcorn balls' for 'DJ Donnie plays the same Santa song on repeat.'
iconic: Fred the Chicago repo man (hot dogs)
Fred marking every naughty child nice (cocoa note)
Slam at the top of the naughty list (wink)
DJ Donnie and Here Comes Santa Claus (cue)
Nick sandbagging Fred into family dinner (ham)
changed: Cue now Fred's fight with DJ Donnie
Cocoa note: naughty list marked nice
Ham note: the dinner Nick talked him into
Winks: Clyde's three strikes, Slam, Chirp Chirp
